title: We should be more ambitious with the software we build
content:
Comments

lukeify · Oct 24, 2026

Agreed. Perhaps we could start with some line length and text wrapping restrictions so we can be respectful of other people reading.

Or even just a nicer font, maybe?

nick__m · Oct 24, 2026

Most browsers have a reader mode that you can configure to your liking.

mindcandy · Oct 24, 2026

Agreed.

I've been seeing too much "I've been coding for decades and what I've always done has be reduced to telling AI to do it for me."

and not nearly enough "I've been coding for decades and recently worked hard for months with AI's help to make something I would have never considered possible before."

Much easier to complain that you are bored than to step back up to high-effort with your new fancy tools.
